performance.verdict: Paid ads dead; organic eroding fast — August scoreboard ungradeable.

findings.text: 5 overdue SOW milestones (oldest: Jul 23) include the Aug 31 dashboard and renewal decision — scoreboard is still unreadable with 0 tracked appointments in GHL.
Phone-match attribution gap (due Aug 7) and contact cleanup (due Aug 14) remain open; 104 GHL opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments recorded — intake data is unreliable.
Zero paid spend across all 28 days and all 45 series days — no Meta, no Google Ads, no leads. CPL is undefined. All results rest entirely on organic.
GBP actions dropped 69.84% (7d vs prior 7d); 3-day signal confirms collapse — last 3 days (Sep 2–4) show 0 GBP actions vs avg ~8/day in prior weeks. Search clicks also fell 35%.
GA4 sessions up 18.46% (7d) — 13, 19, 9, 11 in last 4 days vs prior avg ~11 — but 0 GA4 conversions recorded across full 45-day window. Tracking is broken or conversion events not configured.

suggestions.text: Clear the Aug 31 dashboard milestone immediately; 0 recorded appointments means the renewal decision has no data to stand on.
suggestions.monday_update: The GHL pipeline shows 104 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won in the 28-day window, making the August scoreboard unreadable. Ahmed/Ali must complete the contact cleanup (due Aug 14) and get the lead-to-patient dashboard live (due Aug 31 — already passed). Success check: at least 1 appointment confirmed in GHL and dashboard accessible to Sohib by 2026-09-08.

suggestions.text: Fix GA4 conversion event — 0 conversions over 45 days with 317 sessions is a broken pixel, not a traffic problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded 317 sessions and 256 users over 28 days but 0 conversions — the conversion event is either misconfigured or unfired. Audit the GA4 goal/event setup and confirm at least 1 conversion fires on a test form submission. Success check: conversions > 0 in GA4 real-time view by 2026-09-08.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP — 0 actions for 4 straight days (Sep 1–4). If zero persists through Sep 8, escalate as channel_dark.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions collapsed to 0 for at least 4 consecutive days (Sep 1–4) after averaging ~8/day earlier in August. This may be a data pipeline gap or a genuine map-pack visibility loss. Check GBP dashboard directly on Sep 8; if actions remain at 0, treat as channel_dark and escalate to Nacer. Success check: actions resume or root cause identified by 2026-09-08.
